successor_act_proposal.rationale: All 12 of the test-side defect clusters share a single repair: introduce a typed `selectScalarArray` (or equivalent) that returns `string[]` from `array_agg(...)` and unwraps it, fix Support.fs compactBodyFor to use the F# struct's ObservedAt for the JSON 'time' field, rewrite the failed-migration test to pre-create a 000002 that actually calls digest() (or to apply 000003 first and assert only 000003 is unrecorded), widen the pg_stat_activity poll to 15s with a session-terminate fallback, and unwrap the AggregateException in the 000003 test. These are test-only changes; production SQL is untouched.

These three clusters are production-side decisions: (a) extend the IngestEventService retry policy to retry 40001 on the projection upsert path; (b) widen the typed NpgsqlException classifier to map P0001 (and any other user-defined ERRCODE) to PersistenceFailure UnexpectedDatabaseFailure, so the trigger-thrown atomicity tests' typed arm is taken; (c) resolve the idempotent-replay contract — either (i) keep the digest-as-identity contract and rewrite the test to use a body that has the same bytes (e.g. trim leading-zero differences), or (ii) change the production idempotency key to (source, event_id) and store the raw_body_sha256 only as a column, accepting that any same-identity follow-up is a replay.
